description: The Kaigu monitoring team publishes two years of groundwater-pressure observations from six wells in an extracted peatland in central Latvia. Measurements run from June 2023 through May 2025 at thirty-minute intervals and include well coordinates, installation elevations, manual checks and reference barometric pressure. Mendeley Data provides an Excel release freely under CC BY 4.0. These site-specific records can calibrate peatland water-balance simulations or compare rewetting designs under different vegetation and moisture conditions. The logged values require atmospheric and elevation corrections before interpretation as water-table depth. Repository and article descriptions use different pressure-unit conventions, so units must be checked against workbook metadata. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Water table depth monitoring extracted peatland, Latvia
